case1_oncoming_headlight_glare.diagnosis: Specular saturation (Y=255) across sensor photodiodes produces severe glare bloom without knee compression.

case2_dark_sky_blue_gray_haze.diagnosis: Uniform dark night sky (Y<15) amplified into noisy gray-blue haze under naive unconstrained curve expansion.

case3_distant_plate_resolution_limit.diagnosis: Beyond a critical distance (>25m) where plate height is <10 pixels, super-resolution recovers contrast and vehicle edges, but cannot synthesize missing alphanumeric characters without OCR prior.
